title: Sum of Decoded Numbers
summary: Given an integer array nums, each element is encoded to represent two positive integers xi and yi.
statement: Given an integer array nums, each element is encoded to represent two positive integers xi and yi. To decode nums[i], calculate widthi as the remainder of nums[i] divided by 10, and di as the integer part of nums[i] divided by 10. xi is the integer formed by the first widthi digits of di, and yi is the integer formed by the remaining digits of di. The decoded value of nums[i] is xi raised to the power of yi. Return the sum of these decoded values modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: For encoded v, width=v mod 10 and body=v//10.
Split body’s decimal text after width digits into positive x and y, then decode as x^y.
Return the sum of decoded values modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Use divmod by ten to separate body and width.
Convert the body to decimal text and split at width.
Apply modular exponentiation to x and y.
Accumulate every decoded power modulo the required constant.
editorial: Accumulate every decoded power modulo the required constant.

tests.explanation: Body 23 split after one digit gives two to the third power, or eight.
The encodings represent one to the twelfth and three to the fourth, summing to 82.
